name: Tilburg University
summary: Campus university in Tilburg for economics, business, law and social sciences; 14 English-taught bachelor's, including a liberal arts college.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, 24+ points, three HL subjects; your school grades are assessed, not predictions. An English-taught IB exempts you from a test. Maths AA HL for Econometrics; AA SL/HL or AI HL for economics and business.

dates.label: Complete application deadline for non-EEA nationals, 23:59 CET
Complete application deadline for EEA nationals, 23:59 CET

programmes.name: Cognitive Science and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL.

programmes.name: Digital Culture and Society
programmes.ib: Non-EEA applicants also have until 1 May.

programmes.name: Double Bachelor: International Business Administration and Economics
programmes.ib: Two BSc degrees in four years: apply to both IBA and Economics, then opt in. Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL.

programmes.name: Entrepreneurship and Business Innovation
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL. Matching: interview an entrepreneur and compare them with one whose biography you read.

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus, 250 English places (2026-27 figure): apply by 15 January, file by 31 January 2027. Grades 40%, online knowledge test in March 60%, plus a motivation task.

programmes.name: Theology
programmes.ib: Matching: a short essay, discussed at a matching interview.

programmes.name: University College Tilburg: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programmes.ib: Selective: application form with a short essay, then an interview. Majors: Interdisciplinary Social Sciences, Cognitive Neuroscience and Behavior, or Law, Politics, and Culture.

notes: Binding study advice: 42 of 60 first-year credits (EC) to continue; Psychology, Econometrics and Liberal Arts and Sciences are piloting a non-binding advice from 2026-27.
Applicants with a non-Dutch diploma, IB included, pay a one-time €100 application fee; some programmes, such as Economics and IBA, then make a matching step mandatory.
Data Science (joint with TU/e) is applied for only via TU/e, and Leisure Studies via Breda University of Applied Sciences, though both appear in Tilburg's list.
